title: Cazuela Wrap with Indian-Style Bacon and Lardon
description: A fusion of Indian flavors with the simplicity of a wrap, featuring crispy bacon and lardon, and a hint of jfestive spice.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the lardon until crispy, then set aside.
Cook the bacon until crispy, then set aside with the lardon.
Add the cazuela to the pan and cook until tender.
Add the jfestive to the pan and stir to combine.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing the cazuela mixture onto the center of the wrap, followed by the bacon and lardon.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up to form a neat package.
